entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: 768-aa query strongly matches reviewed HIV-1 gp160 (74.8% identity; 100% query coverage; E-value 0).
Env gp160 is cleaved by host furin-like proteases into gp120 and gp41; gp120 mediates receptor attachment and gp41 mediates membrane fusion.
Sequence scan identified GP120 domains at residues 32–137 and 141–490 and GP41 domain at residues 509–699.
